_comment: Sessions used by every day3 script. To add a session collected later, add one entry: loader 'clean_tree' reads any folder built by clean-data/2026-11-24/scripts/build_clean.py (manifest.csv, floor*/stops|walks/<folder>/<phone>/<Sensor>.csv, wifi/observations.csv); 'names' maps its node names onto graph-v2 place names (see names_24nov.csv for the columns). Then rerun: sh phase2/new/day3/run_all.sh

phones._comment: Handset identity. Key = deviceModel read from each recording's meta/device.csv (phone_map.py). id = stable label used in files, results.json and keys; display = the name shown in the HTML pages, figures and tables, so rename display (e.g. "Michael's iPhone") and rerun, no code change. Per the user (2026-11-25): iPhone17,4 is an iPhone 16, iPhone19,2 an iPhone 18. A model id not listed here stops the pipeline instead of being guessed.

sessions.note: stops only logged magnetometer + barometer (ip16 = iPhone17,4), no accelerometer, so no tilt features
4 phones; iPhone slot = ip18 (iPhone19,2), not the same handset as 24s2
2 phones; iPhone slot = ip16 (iPhone17,4, the 23-Nov stop handset)
